build_escnmd_backbone: build an eSCNMDBackbone equivariant graph neural network model for molecular energy and force prediction
create_mlp_efs_head: create an MLP_EFS_Head to predict energy, forces, and stress via autograd derivatives from node embeddings
create_mlp_stress_head: create an MLP_Stress_Head to predict isotropic and anisotropic stress tensor components from node embeddings
create_linear_force_head: create a Linear_Force_Head using SO3_Linear to predict direct forces from equivariant node embeddings
create_linear_energy_head: create a Linear_Energy_Head to predict system energy by reducing node embeddings through a linear layer
